# Custom Settings

Approved project-level tunable product limits and defaults.

| Setting | Value | Purpose |
| --- | ---: | --- |

Typical settings: maximum lengths, page-size defaults and maximums, retention periods, numeric thresholds and other stable project-specific tunable values. What may be stored here, approval of new values and conflicts with `SPECIFICATION.md`: CLAUDE.md § Product Inputs. Applying a change: `custom-settings` workflow.
